# Recurring Requirements Checklist: Recurring Transactions (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 010 — no duplicate transactions, balance exactness, offline confirmation, schedule parity with the server, series edits, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): money-correctness risks (duplicates, balance, schedule parity, split), then contract fidelity and UX completeness; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, plan, research or contracts in the same session; each says where. Unchecked items were reviewed and hold; they stay open for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the verification gate specified for occurrence writes (confirm, skip, edit), not only rule creation? [Gap → fixed: FR-002 "Every rule or occurrence write …"]
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified whether a waiting confirmation can be changed or cancelled before it syncs, and what happens to its pending transaction? [Gap → fixed: FR-021 last sentence; contracts/recurring-domain.md `cancelConfirmation`; ui-and-e2e `occurrence.cancelConfirm`]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified what opening a pending-confirmation transaction from the transactions list does? [Gap → fixed: FR-022 "opening that transaction MUST open the occurrence"]
- [x] CHK004 Are occurrences' displayed values defined while a rule edit waits (server re-derives them later)? [Gap → fixed: FR-039]
- [x] CHK005 Is pull to refresh on the recurring screens specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-029 last sentence]
- [ ] CHK006 Are all four rule actions (pause, resume, end, delete) and their confirmations specified, including the ended-rule restriction? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK007 Are all server answers of each write mapped to an outcome (201/200, 409 live/tombstone/confirmed, each 422 pointer, 403 ×2, 404)? [Completeness, Spec §5, contracts/recurring-api-client.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the one-time wallet-position reset on upgrade specified with its user-visible effect (copy kept while re-reading)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, research R-02]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "shown prominently" for due items quantified (where, how many, ordering)? [Clarity → fixed: FR-019 "at most 3 … missed first, then oldest … See all (n)"]
- [x] CHK010 Is "later unconfirmed rounds go away" on End precise about due rounds dated on or before today? [Ambiguity → fixed: FR-015 (only rounds dated after the rule's today; due ones stay)]
- [x] CHK011 Is the Home due count's population defined (viewer wallets included or not)? [Clarity → fixed: FR-019 "only … owner or editor"]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the match rule for "Confirm … instead" fully specified (wallet, kind, category/destination, ±7 days, received, unconfirmed)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031, contracts/recurring-domain.md §2]
- [ ] CHK013 Are "due" and "missed" defined exactly as the backend defines them, including the payout exception? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, ADR-0018 rule 8]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the time zone used for "today" defined for both accepted and never-accepted rules, with a fallback? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Edge Cases, research R-08]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Do the category choices for a confirmation agree with the backend rule "own or platform, unless unchanged"? [Consistency → fixed: FR-021 "C5's choices … with the occurrence's current category kept"]
- [ ] CHK016 Is "Make recurring" consistent with ADR-0018 rule 6 (no hand transaction linked) and with FR-003 (only the rule saved)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications Q1]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the frozen members in FR-013 identical to recurring.yaml's list (incl. amount and count for gam'eya/total)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, recurring.yaml upsertRecurringRule]
- [ ] CHK018 Do spec §3, data-model.md and research R-02/R-07 agree on the migration's contents (two tables, `pending_confirmation`, wallet positions only)? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Is SC-002 (schedule parity) verifiable against real server answers, with the test table named? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, quickstart Host QA]
- [ ] CHK020 Is SC-004 (zero duplicates) tied to concrete race scenarios (retry, lost answer, process death, auto-confirm race)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Edge Cases]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are clashes covered for each pair: confirm vs auto-confirm, confirm vs rule edit, skip vs confirm elsewhere, change vs rule deletion? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the split failure path (end refused, clashed then discarded, discarded) specified with no overlapping rules left? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, research R-09]
- [ ] CHK024 Are month-end, leap-day and interval > 1 cases specified for every frequency? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is behaviour defined for unknown enum values from a later server? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-034, research R-15]
- [ ] CHK026 Is a pending confirmation whose produced transaction was deleted before the phone read it handled? [Edge Case, research R-07 `sweepConfirmations`]
